reverse-index-lookup.description: Replace O(n*m) record iteration with O(1) reverse index lookup for item removal

fastapi-route-ordering.description: FastAPI route ordering fix: Static path segments (like /bulk) must be defined before dynamic path parameters (like /{id}) to prevent incorrect matching
fastapi-route-ordering.template: Move routes with static paths (e.g., /bulk/resolve, /bulk/archive) BEFORE routes with path parameters (e.g., /{thread_id}). Also ensure routers with static paths are included before routers with dynamic paths in app.include_router().
